meta.name: optimizing-query-by-id
meta.description:
Optimizes Snowflake query performance using query ID from history. Use when optimizing Snowflake queries for:
(1) User provides a Snowflake query_id (UUID format) to analyze or optimize
(2) Task mentions "slow query", "optimize", "query history", or "query profile" with a query ID
(3) Analyzing query performance metrics - bytes scanned, spillage, partition pruning
(4) User references a previously run query that needs optimization
Fetches query profile, identifies bottlenecks, returns optimized SQL with expected improvements.

copy.tagline: 根据查询ID自动分析并优化Snowflake查询性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要排查和优化Snowflake上的慢查询
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze and optimize Snowflake query performance by query ID
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to troubleshoot and optimize slow Snowflake queries

howto.what: 当你给出一个 Snowflake 查询 ID，Claude 会获取该查询的详细指标，分析性能瓶颈（如扫描数据量、溢出、分区修剪），然后返回优化后的 SQL 语句和预期改进。
howto.when: 当你提到一个 Snowflake 查询 ID（UUID 格式），或要求优化慢查询、分析查询历史时触发。

say.text: 分析查询 ID 'abc123' 的性能瓶颈
say.note: Claude 会获取查询指标并指出问题。

howto.what_en: When you provide a Snowflake query ID, Claude fetches its metrics, analyzes bottlenecks (e.g., data scanned, spillage, partition pruning), and returns an optimized SQL query with expected improvements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a Snowflake query ID (UUID format) or ask to optimize a slow query or analyze query history.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and suggest optimizations.
Claude will fetch metrics and identify issues.
